reason: The hypothesis directly restates the core finding of P1/P15—that restricted atom mobility in a solid precursor drives single-phase HEA formation—and proposes testing it by subtly modifying the thermal history, which is the same variable already explored in P14 (fast vs. slow moving bed pyrolysis) and P21 (dropwise injection rate). The mechanism, predicted outcome, and falsification test are all taken from these sources without combining them in a new way or transferring the idea to a new system.
